channel.title: AutoTelegramForward — releases and feature deep dives
channel.description: AutoTelegramForward is a self-hosted Telegram message routing platform. This feed carries every release note and every feature deep dive.

item.title: v2.0 — Multi-Source Routing, Per-Task Policies, AI Control & Full Observability
item.description: v2.0 turns the forwarder into a routing platform: one task fans out from any number of sources to any number of targets, each with its own content policy. AI rewriting is switchable per task, the whole stack is observable, scriptable and upgradeable from the command line, and both clients share one contract-gated system surface. Highlights: M sources → N targets per task, with the primary mirror kept in step by a single sanctioned write path · Per-task content rules (metadata["content_policy"]) plus per-source and per-target overrides that are additive only · Unicode-folded, word-boundary keyword matching — one blacklist catches Persian, Arabic and English spellings alike · ReDoS-refused regex gates, single-pass deterministic replacements and cheapest-first evaluation

item.title: DevOps CLI & upgrades — AutoTelegramForward
item.description: 29 command groups cover setup, tasks, logs, backups, docker, k8s and TLS, with a read-only validator for CI and an upgrade engine behind a health gate.

item.title: Multilingual UI — AutoTelegramForward
item.description: English, Persian, Russian, Chinese, Portuguese, Uzbek, Indonesian, Spanish, French and Italian share one catalog with enforced 1:1 parity.

item.title: Clients & interfaces — AutoTelegramForward
item.description: Telegram bot UI, React dashboard behind a Rust Axum gateway, Flutter client and a REST/gRPC control plane — all enforced against the same contract fixtures.

item.title: Dedup, replies & edits — AutoTelegramForward
item.description: SHA-256 content and album fingerprinting kills duplicate forwards, reply chains stay linked, and edits and deletions propagate within a bounded window.

item.title: Ordered delivery — AutoTelegramForward
item.description: Lease-based durable workers, per-channel delivery lanes that preserve post order, atomic cursor persistence, retry with jitter, and no duplicate sends.

item.title: Observability & log history — AutoTelegramForward
item.description: Every delivery is attributable: the central logger stores queryable history with service, owner and correlation id, and dead letters can be replayed.

item.title: AI rewriting — AutoTelegramForward
item.description: Enable or disable LLM rewriting per task, pick a provider, write your own prompts with version history, and keep forwarding even when the model is unreachable.

item.title: Per-task content rules — AutoTelegramForward
item.description: Blacklists, whitelists, link handling, regex gates, length limits and ordered replacements — evaluated cheapest-first, with per-source and per-target overrides.

item.title: Multi-source → multi-target routing — AutoTelegramForward
item.description: A single task can watch any number of source chats and deliver to any number of targets, with the primary pair mirrored and forum topics addressable per target.

item.title: Mobile release hardening
item.description: Android permission and packaging fixes on top of the Flutter client preview. Highlights: INTERNET permission restored in the Android manifest · Release APK and Play Store bundle pipeline stabilised · Mobile reachability probing before any credential prompt

item.title: Flutter client parity pass
item.description: Mobile client aligned with the dashboard surface and the localization rules. Highlights: RTL/LTR layout handling verified on Android · Secure credential storage for sessions and passwords · Protocol version compatibility check against the API

item.title: Flutter mobile client
item.description: First packaged mobile release mirroring the dashboard capabilities. Highlights: Native Android build embedding the full control surface · Encrypted local storage of the dashboard token · Live health and topology screen on mobile

item.title: Bot-layer tenant isolation
item.description: Fail-closed ownership enforcement extended into the Telegram bot layer. Highlights: Numeric-id authorization for every bot action · Clean onboarding for unlinked users (no premature dashboard links) · Structured [PIPELINE:*] logging across the bot commands
